summary: Cages is a 2005 film directed by American filmmaker Graham Streeter. It follows Ali Tan, a single mother (played by Tan Kheng Hua) who tries to escape a series of bad relationships, which leads her to confront the father she resents most, Tan (Mako Iwamatsu). When her father reveals a dark secret from 20 years earlier, the truth threatens to cost her a lifetime of relationships.
one_line: Cages is a 2005 film by Graham Streeter about a single mother confronting her estranged father and a buried family secret.
